evidence.observation: H701 temperature reads 373.963 °C, far above the other reboiler heater and vessel.
Reading has risen monotonically to 381.539 °C while other temperatures remain nearly steady; possible local overheating or temperature-measurement fault.
T702 is 75.794 °C and T703 is 65.757 °C, compared with 75.858 °C and 65.565 °C initially; neither corroborates the T701 rise.
System pressure is 398.619 mbar and differential pressures are 0.152 and 2.213 mbar, with no sustained pressure rise over the observations.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint, permitted surface-temperature range and power history, plus an independent heater-temperature measurement to distinguish actual overheating from sensor drift or scaling error; composition measurements and separation target are also absent.
